ignoreValues.reason: DESIGN.md names Copernicus and Tiempos Headline, both commercially licensed and unavailable here. Newsreader is the closest free Google Fonts equivalent and is loaded as the --font-display stack head with the DESIGN.md names retained as fallbacks.

DESIGN.md (the getdesign claude system) specifies the sans stack as StyreneB, Inter, sans-serif. StyreneB is a commercial Anthropic face and is not available, so Inter is the documented fallback rather than a default reached for. Pairs with the existing Newsreader ignore for Copernicus/Tiempos Headline.

Claude decided: the only match is .tooth-part-transition animating stroke-width on SVG tooth paths (globals.css L1480). stroke-width is an SVG paint property, not box layout - it triggers no document reflow, and the rule's named properties (width/height/padding/margin) do not appear in the declaration. There is no transform or opacity equivalent for stroke thickness, so the suggested alternative cannot express this hover affordance.
